subject: apps/web/src/features/auth/sign-in-look.test.tsx

subject: apps/web/src/features/settings/settings.test.tsx

The Back link height is owned by the kit page header and its test; the 390 measurement of the selects and the Name box is in the PR evidence; a follow-up issue moves the phone height rule for selects and inputs into the touch-targets guard.
